title: Sweet Chinese Figs Bao
description: A sweet and pillowy Chinese dish featuring figs, perfect for a post-workout snack or dessert. This dish is smoke-cold and Buddhist-temple-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, sugar, and salt.
Gradually add in vegetable oil and sesame oil, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of fig jam in the center of each disk.
Top the fig jam with a few pieces of chopped dried figs.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the bao.
Place the bao in the steamer basket, leaving some space between each bao.
Steam the bao over boiling water for 12 minutes.
Serve the bao warm or at room temperature.
